moduleUUID.description: The UUID to place inside the manifest module.

modules.description: The scripting modules to inject as dependencies. Use "auto" to derive them from the dependencies of data/gametests/package.json, or "auto-dev" to also include devDependencies.

anyOf.description: Derive modules from data/gametests/package.json ("auto-dev" also includes devDependencies).

outfile.description: The path to place the built script file at when buildOptions.bundle is enabled. This property is also used as the entry point for the script module.

outdir.description: The path to build to when buildOptions.bundle is disabled.

moduleType.description: The manifest module type to inject

debugBuild.description: Enables debug mode for the build. This will enable source maps and add debug launch configuration to `.vscode/launch.json`.

injectSourceMapping.description: Injects source mapping into a compiled script file. Requires debugBuild to be enabled.

disableManifestModification.description: Disables adding dependencies and script module to the manifest.

comptime.description: Enables build-time evaluation of comptime() calls imported from the virtual 'comptime' module.

dropLabeledCalls.description: When a function's body consists entirely of labels removed by buildOptions.dropLabels, calls to that function (including their arguments) are removed as well.

skipDependencyCheck.description: Skips checking whether data/gametests' npm dependencies are installed. Has no effect when modules is "auto" or "auto-dev".
